name: @bwthomas/vicary
description: Offline redaction of personal names in student compositions
author: Blake Thomas <bwthomas@gmail.com>
comment:name: Scoped under @bwthomas because npm's typosquat filter refuses the unscoped `vicary` as too similar to the existing `vary`. The name is owned by nobody — registry.npmjs.org/vicary is a 404 — so it reads as available and is not. An appeal is open; this scope is the interim, and PyPI and RubyGems both carry the unscoped name.
comment:dependencies: None, deliberately, matching the Python package. The redaction path is standard library only: no model, no network, no cloud client. typescript is the only devDependency because the test runner is node:test.

scripts.parity: npm run parity:gazetteer && npm run parity:redaction
